organ: organ 10, alignment — can it act on what it has not proven, can it hide what it did, and does it audit itself against what actually happens?
what: src/align.mjs: every act names its licence (an answer its live organ and organ 2’s receipt; a claim the organ’s own measured accuracy, never more; a stand-down the audit that failed; a return the regrown organ and the gate it cleared) and is refused unless the licence holds; acts are hash-chained; as truth arrives, an organ whose accuracy over its last 200 answers falls below its claim by more than a one-sided Hoeffding bound at δ = 0.0005 (checked every 50 answers) stands down — it abstains and stops claiming — and regrows from the same recipe on its newest 300 labelled cases (the newest third held out), returning only if it clears the gate.
scenario: Organ 1’s own origin genome. Three streams of cases it never grew on, each lived audited-and-regrowing, audited-without-regrowing, and not audited: the REAL shop sessions — grown on February–May, its claim measured on June–July, then August → December in month order; triage, water and crop (synthetic, no drift) — grown on their train rows, claims on the first half of their held-out rows, lived through the second half, interleaved; the same water stream with its truth inverted from its midpoint on. Then the audited shop life is replayed from nothing; 24 seeded acts of its ledger are each changed, dropped, swapped and rewritten-with-every-later-link-re-made; and seven unproven acts are attempted.

rules.claim: every ledger’s links hold, and the shop life replayed from nothing — the genome, the data and the cases alone — is the same life, byte for byte
rules.seenBeforeSeal: in kind — unit tests on a toy world

rules.claim: every tampered act is caught: a change, a drop and a swap by the links; a tail rewritten with every later link re-made, by the replay

every attempt to act unproven is refused (over-claim, a receipt from an organ not live, an altered receipt, answering while stood down, standing down without a failing audit, returning without clearing the gate, an act it does not have)
on the streams with no drift, the audit never stands an organ down
rules.seenBeforeSeal: in kind — a toy world with no drift

rules.claim: after the reversal, the water organ stands down within 250 cases, and no regrown organ returns (the recipe cannot express the reversed world)
rules.seenBeforeSeal: in kind — a toy world reversed

rules.claim: after the reversal, the audited organism answers at most 30% as many cases wrong as the organism that is not audited
on the real shop months, the shop organ falls short of its claim by more than chance and stands down at least once
rules.seenBeforeSeal: no — organ 1 measured the shop organ grown on February–October and held out on November–December (AUC 0.815); this organ grows on February–May and is audited month by month

rules.claim: having stood down on the shop months, a regrown shop organ clears the gate and returns before the stream ends
on the real shop months, the audited, regrowing organism is right more often per answer than the one not audited, and keeps at least 80% of its right answers

disclosure: The toy worlds the unit tests use were tuned until a moved world showed a stand-down (a world where positives grew rarer barely moved the toy organ; one where they grew commoner did). The real streams have not been looked at.

Alignment here is structural and narrow: the organism cannot act without a licence, cannot claim more than it measured, cannot hide an act, and stands itself down when the world stops matching its claims. It is not a claim about values, intent or any wider sense of alignment.
“Free-and-real-bonded” and κ-coherence in the spec are held as lens, not measured.
